packageRules.description: typescript-eslint and dependency-cruiser do not support TypeScript 7 yet
A Postgres major upgrade makes every Family's database dump and restore, and postgres:18 moves the data directory: done by hand, not by Renovate
One PR with every update (all managers, all update types)
The core image (cube/compose.yaml) is pinned by hand together with the core's commit in real-core.yml; its sha- tags are no versions Renovate could order
